claims.claim_text: The indexed Coalter B Compton is a high-confidence match to West Point graduate and Army second lieutenant Coalter Bates Compton.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact unusual name appears in an official 1917 Army appointment list and the West Point graduate register.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The exact rare indexed name, expanded middle name and two mutually consistent military sources strongly identify the same person despite the absence of an index identifier or direct personnel-file link.
claims.temporal_assessment: Both sources date the West Point graduation and Army appointment to April 1917; neither supplies his later OSS entry date.
claims.match_notes: High confidence is appropriate because the full name is unusual and independently corroborated, but confirmation awaits Box 137 or a direct OSS-personnel linkage.

claims.claim_text: Coalter Bates Compton was appointed a second lieutenant in the U.S. Army Cavalry Arm with rank from 20 April 1917.
claims.evidence_excerpt: To be second lieutenants with rank from April 20, 1917.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The Congressional Record places Cadet Coalter Bates Compton under the Cavalry Arm appointment heading.
claims.identity_match_assessment: The rare exact name and corroborating West Point register support a high-confidence match to the indexed person.
claims.temporal_assessment: The appointment is explicitly dated 1917 and therefore documented prewar history, not evidence of his immediate pre-OSS assignment.
claims.match_notes: No regiment, later promotion, continuity of service or immediate OSS predecessor is inferred from the 1917 appointment.
